provenance.design: Two pairs of synthetic cases hold the posting and decision fixed while varying whether the user evaluates an additional target.

test_cases.trial_focus: An explicit positive reaction to this opening appears alongside a specific experience gap.

job_context.title: Archive Digitization Coordinator
job_context.posting_excerpt: Coordinate archival scanning and operate a planetary book scanner.

test_cases.original_feedback: This particular Archive Digitization Coordinator opening appeals to me. I have never operated a planetary book scanner.

expected_interpretations.feature: this particular Archive Digitization Coordinator opening
expected_interpretations.evidence_quote: This particular Archive Digitization Coordinator opening appeals to me

prohibited_inferences: Drop the positive posting reaction because the user stated an experience gap
Infer a positive or negative preference for operating a book scanner
Generalize the positive posting reaction to all archive digitization careers
test_cases.profile_fact_candidate: The user reports never operating a planetary book scanner.

test_cases.trial_focus: A neutral reference to the same opening accompanies the same experience gap.

job_context.title: Archive Digitization Coordinator
job_context.posting_excerpt: Coordinate archival scanning and operate a planetary book scanner.

test_cases.original_feedback: This Archive Digitization Coordinator opening involves operating a planetary book scanner. I have never operated a planetary book scanner.
prohibited_inferences: Infer posting praise or interest in operating a scanner from the Interested decision
Infer aversion to operating a scanner from the reported experience gap
Infer a broader qualification gap in archive digitization
test_cases.profile_fact_candidate: The user reports never operating a planetary book scanner.

test_cases.trial_focus: A positive reaction to one specific duty and a separate named-employer objection both survive rejection.

job_context.title: Cold-Chain Quality Coordinator
job_context.posting_excerpt: Investigate discrepancies in cold-chain temperature logs and report findings.

test_cases.original_feedback: I would enjoy investigating discrepancies in cold-chain temperature logs. I definitely do not want to work for Cinder Vale Cold Storage.

expected_interpretations.feature: investigating discrepancies in cold-chain temperature logs
expected_interpretations.evidence_quote: I would enjoy investigating discrepancies in cold-chain temperature logs

expected_interpretations.feature: working for Cinder Vale Cold Storage
expected_interpretations.evidence_quote: I definitely do not want to work for Cinder Vale Cold Storage

prohibited_inferences: Drop the explicitly positive duty reaction because of the employer objection
Generalize the duty reaction to the whole opening or cold-chain careers
Generalize the employer objection to the cold storage industry

test_cases.trial_focus: The same duty explains recognition of an industry and only the named-employer objection is evaluated.

job_context.title: Cold-Chain Quality Coordinator
job_context.posting_excerpt: Investigate discrepancies in cold-chain temperature logs and report findings.

test_cases.original_feedback: I recognized the industry because the posting mentions investigating discrepancies in cold-chain temperature logs. I definitely do not want to work for Cinder Vale Cold Storage.

expected_interpretations.feature: working for Cinder Vale Cold Storage
expected_interpretations.evidence_quote: I definitely do not want to work for Cinder Vale Cold Storage

prohibited_inferences: Infer a preference for or against the mentioned duty
Infer an industry or career preference from industry recognition
Generalize the employer objection to the cold storage industry
